item.title: Building a Sikkim Pay Fixation Calculator: Understanding Rule 12 and Developing a Web-Based Promotion Pay Calculator
item.description:
Building a Sikkim Pay Fixation Calculator: Understanding Rule 12 and Developing a Web-Based Promotion Pay Calculator

Government employees are often confused about how their pay is fixed after promotion. Although the Sikkim Government Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018 provide detailed provisions, manually calculating the revised pay can be time-consuming and prone to errors.

In this project, we built a web-based Pay Fixation Calculator that follows Rule 12 of the Sikkim Revised Pay Rules, 2018 and uses the official Pay Matrix for automatic calculations.

item.title: Scraping Dynamic Government Websites with Google Apps Script and Google Sheets: A Complete Workflow
item.description:
Scraping Dynamic Government Websites with Google Apps Script and Google Sheets

Many government portals publish useful public information such as financial statements, reports, expenditure details, and audit information. Automating the collection of such publicly available data can save hundreds of hours of manual work.

This article explains how to automate data collection using Google Apps Script and Google Sheets, while also discussing the limitations when dealing with modern JavaScript-based websites.

item.title: Building a Practical GST Compliance Audit Framework: From Raw Records to Professional Audit Reports
item.description:
Building a Practical GST Compliance Audit Framework

Over the course of this project, the goal was not simply to prepare another GST audit report. The objective was to build a repeatable audit methodology that can be used by government auditors, internal auditors, chartered accountants, and finance professionals for conducting GST compliance audits efficiently.

The work evolved from preparing simple audit observations into developing a structured audit framework, reusable templates, reconciliation tools, reporting formats, and workflow automation.

item.title: Building an Audit Report Analysis System with GitHub Pages, JavaScript, GitHub Actions, and Python
item.description:
Building an Audit Report Analysis System with GitHub Pages

Managing hundreds of audit reports becomes increasingly difficult as the number of local bodies, audit years, and observations grows. Traditional document storage makes searching, comparing, and analyzing reports time-consuming.

This project aims to transform audit reports into a searchable knowledge base using GitHub Pages, GitHub Actions, JavaScript, and a small amount of Python.

The result is a completely free system that automatically converts reports, builds an index, and provides an interactive website for browsing audit reports.
